title: Meta-crisis: capability outruns governance
summary: Capabilities grow exponentially; governance evolves linearly. The space between the curves is the catastrophe corridor. A new coordination architecture capable of governing exponential technology is what narrows it.
source: Ch01 — Schmachtenberger, the meta-crisis (re-homes the Verdon acceleration-gap figure from ChX)

nodes.label: Coordination Architecture
nodes.description: Systems built to govern exponential technology

nodes.label: Catastrophe Corridor
nodes.description: The gap between what technology can do and what coordination can govern

edges.description: The gap is where catastrophe happens

identifiability_note: Single trajectory; the uncoordinated counterfactual is not observable. The original ChX graph had a gap-to-bridge balancing loop that the ch01 text does not argue; it is dropped here.
